attributes.description: Identifies files written to disk whose SHA-256 hash matches a Tawny Tinderbox banking trojan sample, as reported in campaign PTF-01103. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.
false_positives: Security testing that replays known indicators.

attributes.name: Tawny Tinderbox Banking Trojan: File with known malicious hash written (PTF-01103)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Tawny Tinderbox Banking Trojan: File with known malicious hash written

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Tawny Tinderbox banking trojan in campaign PTF-01103.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
